summary: BusyBox's acpid on os-real acting on the keys the kernel reports; the scenario is machine/acpid_scenario.c, the actions are under krffs/acpi and init starts acpid with the sbin directories on its path (utils/init.c)

cases.behavior: on os-real with an Intel HDA controller and one software Wi-Fi radio, logged in as root, init runs one acpid; with the volume at 50, the volume keys pressed on the PS/2 keyboard step mixer's reading to 55 and back to 50, the mute key mutes and then unmutes it, acpid and update have init's PATH /sbin:/usr/sbin:/bin:/usr/bin, the airplane action /etc/acpi/wifi run in acpid's environment blocks the radio's rfkill switch and run again unblocks it, and the ACPI power button that QMP's system_powerdown presses powers the machine off through init and the kernel's orderly stop

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes its evidence, which it keeps after a failure

steps.does: boot os-real and log in as root at the console
count acpid's processes, set the volume to 50, and press the volume keys and the mute key twice through QMP, reading mixer after each
read the PATH of acpid and of update from /proc/PID/environ, and run /etc/acpi/wifi twice under env -i with acpid's environment, reading the Wi-Fi switch's soft block after each
press the power button with QMP's system_powerdown and wait for the machine's end

assertions.checks: mixer vol 50 leaves mixer reading vol 50:50
the volume-up key moves mixer's reading to vol 55:55
the volume-down key moves it back to vol 50:50
the mute key moves it to vol 0:0 muted
the mute key again moves it back to vol 50:50
the one Wi-Fi switch under /sys/class/rfkill starts with soft block 0
the airplane action in acpid's environment exits 0 and leaves the switch's soft block 1
the action again exits 0 and leaves the soft block 0
after system_powerdown the machine ends by QEMU's SHUTDOWN event
before the end the kernel says shutdown: Stopping the system, which only reboot(2) through init says

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case presses keys and the power button through QMP, which a native run has not
